prerequisite: B2C failed because its frozen identity oracle mixed rounded endpoint semantics with nominal pre-rounding increments
purpose: Separate source-algebra numerical evaluation error from synthetic endpoint-construction error before any infiltration-front implementation.

oracle.endpoint_semantics: Decimal.from_float of the exact binary64 values theta_i, theta_d, K_i, K_d, G_eff, h_p and z, followed by the source Eq18 algebra at 80-digit precision
oracle.reason: This tests whether binary64 evaluation represents the same algebra for the actual values supplied to the kernel, without treating pre-rounding synthetic increments as if they were the same data.

representations.delta_theta: binary64 theta_d-theta_i computed once from the same endpoints
representations.delta_K: binary64 K_d-K_i computed once from the same endpoints
representations.architectural_role: optional immutable shared parameter cache, not dynamic state

frozen_source_algebra_metric.interpretation: 64*binary64_epsilon; this is an algebra-evaluation criterion, not a hydraulic-accuracy tolerance

required_reports: max and p99 normalized forward error for both representations
max relative mismatch between nominal generated delta_theta and endpoint-derived delta_theta
max relative mismatch between nominal generated delta_K and endpoint-derived delta_K
Green-Ampt one-bin identity evaluated in Decimal80
zero-capillary conductivity finite-difference identity in Decimal80
whether precomputed deltas change any source value relative to the same endpoint semantics
hard_guards: B2C remains FAIL and is not rewritten.
No physical equation term, sign convention or source interpretation may change in R1.
Nominal pre-rounding increment mismatch is diagnostic and may not be silently counted as source-algebra error.
Precomputed deltas, if retained later, are immutable shared parameter data and not per-column dynamic state.
No dry-bin creation, rainfall allocation, G_eff closure, merge or groundwater interaction is qualified here.
